name: What does interior finish carpentry include?

mainEntity.name: What does interior finish carpentry include?

acceptedAnswer.text: Interior finish carpentry includes all visible woodwork and architectural trim installed after rough framing, insulation, and drywall are complete. Common projects involve installing baseboards, crown molding, interior doors, window casings, door jambs, wainscoting, and decorative wall paneling. At HH Remodeling, owner Abraham Becerra handles these installations directly alongside our crew. Because finish carpentry creates the final surface lines throughout a room, any unevenness in subfloors or older drywall must be addressed during installation to ensure tight, seamless miters and level profiles before final interior painting.
acceptedAnswer.description: Interior finish carpentry includes baseboards, crown molding, interior doors, window trim, casing, and custom wall paneling installed after framing and drywall are finished.
